The interaction between the hands and the rifle is ambiguous. The fingers blending into the grip and forend lack clear definition, suggesting minor fusion or anatomical simplification common in AI generation.
The scope appears slightly misaligned with the receiver axis, and the mounting rings are indistinct, lacking precise geometric rigidity.
